note: Pokémon-specific moments (Beta 0.6). Catalog: docs/updates/beta-0.6/pokemon-moments-catalog.md. Entries with status "disabled" are designed but not built yet (later batches).

moments.name: Failure Will (NOT) Be Tolerated
moments.effectText: Instead of the run-end screen: revive at 150% max HP (heal fully, then max HP x1.5 for the battle), gain Overcharged for the rest of the battle. Overcharged: every move has a 1-turn cooldown (cannot be used two turns in a row), all five stats x2. Ends when the battle ends. One claim per run, win or lose the roll.
moments.presentation: Screen fades to black, static + electrical crackle 1.2 s, robotic voice reads 4 lines (see catalog notes), electric flare, Overcharged theme loop while active | stand-in voice + theme | "Primary Goal: Protect father. Failed."

moments.name: Dragon's Pride
